capturePerformance.scope: One-frame diagnostic readback; not interactive frame timing

limitations: Local normalized correlation on native pixels, sampled on a grid; not a human perceptual model.
Alternate matches include inherent harmonic repetitions; they are candidates, not proof of perceived ghost layers.

fidelity.scope: RGB error versus aligned original render; not a perceptual fusion score

normalPagePerformance.settings: Quiet stereo; 65% support; Auto quality; full scale; no QA readbacks
normalPagePerformance.scope: One normal-page observation, not a hardware/browser benchmark. Completion includes scheduling, not just GPU execution.

humanFeedback.surface: User reported no fusion: doubled original artwork and random rectangles of noise. Sparse experiment removed from game selector, retained in lab/API for research.

limitations: Color error measures resemblance, not perceived banding or human stereo comfort.
Quiet stereo retains every original visible correspondence; lower dot contrast reduces decoder confidence.
Horizontal color mixing/repetition and inherent alternate matches remain.
The decoder receives final pixels and calibration only; source depth/color are introduced separately for comparison.
Embedded browser preview screenshots are compressed and are not fusion test images.
